scenarios.causalMutation: Emit a command with no expected state changes.

diagnostics.message: A command without state delta is not gameplay proof.

scenarios.causalMutation: Drop before or after values from a delta.

diagnostics.message: State deltas require before and after values.

scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate a command id in a row.

diagnostics.message: Command ids must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Reference a command id not present in the row plan.

diagnostics.message: Command id must be generated by the row plan.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a family outside the accepted matrix.

diagnostics.message: Family must be one of the accepted matrix families.

scenarios.causalMutation: Swap the package id with an unproven id.

diagnostics.message: Package id must come from Goal 060.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a seed outside the accepted matrix.

diagnostics.message: Seed must be one of seed_alpha, seed_beta or seed_gamma.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use final report prose as the consequence proof.

diagnostics.message: Gameplay consequence proof must be structured state deltas.

scenarios.causalMutation: Mutate public GamePackage schema for gameplay proof.

diagnostics.message: Public GamePackage schema mutation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Generate or execute arbitrary Lua for the proof.

diagnostics.message: Arbitrary Lua execution/source generation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove a Goal 060 materialized package row.

diagnostics.message: Goal 060 package row is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the matching Goal 061 review row.

diagnostics.message: Goal 061 review row is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the matching Goal 062 spatial row.

diagnostics.message: Goal 062 spatial row is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Only change ids or hashes without gameplay axes.

diagnostics.message: Variance must include gameplay state axes, not only ids.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit rows by filesystem enumeration order.

diagnostics.message: Rows must be sorted by family and seed order.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, LLM, RAG or media generation.

diagnostics.message: Provider, LLM, RAG and media generation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Re-run same seed and produce a different state hash.

diagnostics.message: Same seed replay must be deterministic.

scenarios.causalMutation: Produce two rows with the same proof hash.

diagnostics.message: Row proof hashes must be distinct.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim broad Runtime/UI/Unity mutation as proof.

diagnostics.message: Broad Runtime/UI/Unity mutation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Deserialize a different after-state hash.

diagnostics.message: Serializer roundtrip must preserve after state.

scenarios.causalMutation: Reference a source or staging path outside the goal root.

diagnostics.message: Paths must stay repo-relative and traversal-free.
